description:
The gate before your agent answers. Call this FIRST for any question, before spending effort: one cheap look returns a routing verdict in a few seconds.

- QUICK_LOOKUP: one page names the answer, with a quote copied from that page. Check the quote, then answer.
- NEEDS_FULL_JOB: worth a full search. Call resolve_fragment with the user's words.
- NOT_WORTH_IT: SF's one look found no page naming an answer, so a full search is unlikely to pay off (about 1 in 10 of these is still findable). Tell the user you cannot place it rather than guessing.
- PROBE_UNAVAILABLE: the look failed. Treat as NEEDS_FULL_JOB.

Every outcome is a routing estimate about SF's own look, never a claim that the thing cannot be found.

fragment.description: The question or half-remembered thing, in the user's own words.
